faqs.question: What quality certifications are supplied with Curry Powder shipments?
faqs.answer: Every commercial consignment is accompanied by Phytosanitary Certificate, Certificate of Origin, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, and certified third-party laboratory analysis (SGS / Eurofins upon buyer request) verifying pesticide MRLs and physical purity.

faqs.question: Can you customize the packaging and mesh size for Curry Powder?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide customizable packaging from 25kg multi-wall paper bags with barrier liners to bulk jumbo bags and private label retail pouch packaging. For ground products, mesh size and grind specification can be calibrated precisely to your processing line.
